description_en: Queries the list of online agent information
description_zh: 查询在线的座席信息列表
name: CloudListOnlineAgent

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Contact Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The queue numbers. If you specify queue numbers, the monitoring information of the corresponding queues is returned. You can specify multiple queue numbers separated by commas (,). If you do not specify this parameter, the monitoring information of all queues is returned
parameters.help_zh: 队列号，指定队列号则查询该队列号所对应队列的监控信息，支持同时查询多个队列号对应队列的监控信息，多个队列号使用英文逗号","分隔，不指定则查询所有队列监控信息
parameters.name: qnos

parameters.help_en: The agent IDs. If you specify agent IDs, the monitoring information of the corresponding agents is returned. You can specify multiple agent IDs separated by commas (,). If you do not specify this parameter, the monitoring information of all agents under the account is returned
parameters.help_zh: 坐席工号，指定座席工号则查询该工号座席的监控信息，可指定多个座席工号，指定多个座席工号使用英文逗号","分隔，不指定则查询所有队列监控信息，不指定则查询该账户下所有座席的监控信息
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en: The agent status codes. You can specify multiple status codes separated by commas (,). Valid values: s1 (idle), s2 (busy), s3 (wrap-up), s4 (calling), s5 (ringing), and s6 (on call)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席状态，s1:空闲，s2:置忙，s3:整理，s4:呼叫中，s5:响铃，s6通话   可传多个状态码，多个值之间以","分隔
parameters.name: state_code

parameters.help_en:
The busy types used to filter monitoring data by agent busy type. You can specify multiple busy types separated by commas (,). If you do not specify this parameter, agents in all states are queried.
Valid values: 1 (normal), 2 (break), 3 (IM), and 4 (forced)
parameters.help_zh:
置忙类型，根据座席置忙类型过滤监控数据，可指定多个置忙类型，指定多个置忙类型使用英文逗号","分隔，不指定则默认查询所有设置状态的座席。
取值说明1普通，2休息，3 IM，4 强制
parameters.name: pause_type

parameters.help_en: The busy reasons used to filter monitoring data by agent busy reason. You can specify multiple busy reasons separated by commas (,). If you do not specify this parameter, agents in all states are queried
parameters.help_zh: 置忙原因，根据座席置忙原因过滤监控数据，可指定多个置忙原因，指定多个置忙原因使用英文逗号","分隔，不指定则默认查询所有设置状态的座席
parameters.name: pause_description

DeviceStatus.description_en: The device status. Valid values: -1 (invalid), 0 (idle), 1 (locked), 2 (calling), 3 (ringing), and 4 (on call)
DeviceStatus.description_zh: 设备状态，-1 失效，0 空闲，1 已锁定，2 呼叫中，3 响铃，4 通话中
DeviceStatus.title_en: 设备状态，-1 失效，0 空闲，1 已锁定，2 呼叫中，3 响铃，4 通话中
DeviceStatus.title_zh: 设备状态，-1 失效，0 空闲，1 已锁定，2 呼叫中，3 响铃，4 通话中

LoginStatus.description_en: The logon status. Valid values: 0 (offline), 1 (online), 2 (busy), and 3 (wrap-up)
LoginStatus.description_zh: 登录状态，0离线，1在线，2置忙，3整理
LoginStatus.title_en: 登录状态，0离线，1在线，2置忙，3整理
LoginStatus.title_zh: 登录状态，0离线，1在线，2置忙，3整理

LoginTime.description_en:
The logon time.

This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
LoginTime.description_zh:
登录时间

使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒

State.description_en: The agent state, which combines the logon status and device status. Valid values: invalid, idle, busy, wrap-up, calling, ringing, and on call
State.description_zh: 座席状态（结合了登录状态和设备状态），失效，空闲，置忙，整理，呼叫中，响铃，通话

State.title_zh: 座席状态（结合了登录状态和设备状态），失效，空闲，置忙，整理，呼叫中，响铃，通话
